detail.title: Investigating Algebraic Stoichiometry and Perturbation Distinctions in Autocatalytic Memory
detail.summary: Continued focused investigation into autocatalytic memory mechanisms. While retrieved mathematical analyses establish algebraic conditions on submatrices of the stoichiometric matrix S for multistability, distinguishing genuine dynamical history-dependent memory from transient hysteresis or slow relaxation requires targeted perturbation regimes. Requested focused research on perturbation experiments in multistable chemical reaction networks.
